items.title: File Widerspruch against the Kinderzuschlag repeal decision
items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 08.07.2026 (Familienkasse, an authority under social law, § 37 SGB X). Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a letter posted by an authority counts as delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the 4th day after the date on the letter; this day does not shift even if it falls on a weekend for social-law letters. 4th day after 08.07.2026 = Sun 12.07.2026 → deemed Bekanntgabe date. The one-month Widerspruch period of § 84 Abs. 1 SGG starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X), i.e. 13.07.2026, and ends one month later on the day with the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 12.08.2026, a Wednesday. That day is a normal working day in NRW, so no further shift (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X). Deadline: 12.08.2026.
